<div style="background-color:#000000;clear:both;height:2pt;page-break-after:always;width:88.24%;border:0;margin:30pt 5.88% 30pt 5.88%;"></div><div style="max-width:100%;padding-left:5.88%;padding-right:5.88%;position:relative;"><div style="margin-top:21.6pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 0pt 30pt 0pt;"><a href="#TOC"><span style="font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;">Table of Contents</span></a></p></div><div style="clear:both;max-width:100%;position:relative;"><a id="_260fba68_943e_445d_a8f2_da13a326a0d1"></a><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-weight:bold;text-align:center;margin:0pt;">MONROE CAPITAL ASSET-BACKED FINANCE COMPANY, LP</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-weight:bold;text-align:center;margin:0pt;">NOTES&#160;TO FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:center;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;"><b style="font-weight:bold;">(unaudited)</b></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="Duration_1_6_2026_To_6_30_2026_ziObVfHW60i3Aa7-v_9Twg" name="us-gaap:OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsDisclosureTextBlock" id="Tb_BxNKqgcPdUao_E9tv5KqRg" continuedAt="Tb_BxNKqgcPdUao_E9tv5KqRg_cont1" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Note&#160;1. Organization and Principal Business</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Monroe Capital Asset-Backed Finance Company, LP (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Partnership</span>&#8221;) was formed on January&#160;6, 2026 as a Delaware limited partnership. On February&#160;19, 2026, the Partnership established <ix:nonFraction unitRef="Unit_Standard_item_La5-Fs6nPUW3x59gmjk9VQ" contextRef="Duration_1_6_2026_To_6_30_2026_ziObVfHW60i3Aa7-v_9Twg" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" name="none:NumberOfRegisteredSeriesOfLimitedPartnershipInterests" scale="0" id="Narr_50mru1wUTkSLSKwB41sKgw">two</ix:nonFraction> registered series of limited partnership interests, Monroe Capital Asset-Backed Finance Company, LP&#8212;Series&#160;I (&#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Series&#160;I</span>&#8221;) and Monroe Capital Asset-Backed Finance Company, LP&#8212;Series&#160;II (&#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Series&#160;II</span>&#8221;). Series&#160;I and Series&#160;II are intended to be treated as separate entities for U.S. federal income tax purposes with segregated assets and liabilities. As of June&#160;30, 2026, only Series&#160;II has accepted seed capital. Series&#160;I is currently not accepting subscriptions to the Partnership. Section&#160;17-218(b)&#160;of the LP Act (as defined below) provides that a Series&#160;established in accordance with Section&#160;17-218(a)&#160;of the LP Act may carry on any lawful business, purpose or activity, other than the business of banking, and has the power and capacity to, in its own name, contract, hold title to assets (including real, personal, and intangible property), grant liens and security interests, and sue and be sued. The Partnership intends for each Series&#160;to conduct its business and enter into contracts in its own name to the extent such activities are undertaken with respect to a particular Series&#160;and title to the relevant property will be held by or for the benefit of, the relevant Series. Under Delaware law, to the extent the records maintained for a Series&#160;account for the assets associated with such Series&#160;separately from the other assets of the Partnership or any other Series, the debts, liabilities, obligations and expenses incurred, contracted for or otherwise existing with respect to such Series&#160;are segregated and enforceable only against the assets of such Series&#160;and not against the assets of the Partnership generally or any other Series. Series&#160;I is intended to be treated as a corporation for U.S. federal income tax purposes, and Series&#160;II is intended to be treated as a partnership for U.S. federal income tax purposes. As of June&#160;30, 2026, the Partnership intends to only offer shares of Series&#160;II. The Partnership intends to conduct its operations and those of its subsidiaries so that each will qualify for exclusions from registration under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">The Partnership is a holding company that seeks to build a diversified portfolio of Asset-Backed Finance Assets (as defined below). The term Asset-Backed Finance Assets, as used herein, refers to a broad spectrum of investment opportunities, often backed by assets used on a day-to-day basis by businesses and individuals, and refers, individually and collectively, to leases, loans, mortgages, mezzanine securities, royalties, residuals, other credit or credit-related obligations or equity interests that are collateralized by, or payable from a stream of payments generated by, a specific pool of real, financial, or other assets. The Partnership&#8217;s investment objective is to build a diversified portfolio of Asset-Backed Finance Assets that will generate attractive, risk-adjusted returns in the form of current income and, to a lesser extent, long-term capital appreciation across all economic cycles, targeting assets that have significant downside protection. The Partnership expects to generally divide the Asset-Backed Finance Assets into two categories: (i)&#160;specialty finance assets, which include royalty finance, consumer finance, litigation finance and fund finance and (ii)&#160;hard assets, which include real estate, digital infrastructure, aircraft finance and equipment finance.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">The Partnership is sponsored by Monroe Capital, LLC and is operated by Monroe Capital Asset Finance Advisors, LLC (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Operating Manager</span>&#8221; and together with its affiliates and subsidiaries, &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Monroe</span>&#8221;). The Partnership through the Operating Manager has access to Monroe&#8217;s asset sourcing, operations and portfolio management capabilities pursuant to an operating agreement with the Operating Manager. The Operating Manager manages the Partnership on a day-to-day basis. Monroe Capital Management Advisors LLC, an affiliate of the Operating Manager (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Administrator</span>&#8221;), provides administration services for the Partnership pursuant to an administration agreement with the Partnership. The General Partner of the Partnership is Monroe Capital Asset-Backed Finance Company GP, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and an affiliate of the Operating Manager.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">The Partnership expects to conduct a continuous private offering of its shares in reliance on exemptions from the registration requirements of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Securities Act</span>&#8221;), to (i)&#160;accredited investors (as defined in Regulation D under the Securities Act) and (ii)&#160;in the case of shares sold outside of the United States, to persons that are not &#8220;U.S. persons&#8221; (as defined in Regulation S under the Securities Act).</p></ix:nonNumeric></div><div style="clear:both;margin-bottom:30pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:center;margin:24pt 0pt 0pt 0pt;">9</p></div></div>
<div style="background-color:#000000;clear:both;height:2pt;page-break-after:always;width:88.24%;border:0;margin:30pt 5.88% 30pt 5.88%;"></div><div style="max-width:100%;padding-left:5.88%;padding-right:5.88%;position:relative;"><div style="margin-top:21.6pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 0pt 30pt 0pt;"><a href="#TOC"><span style="font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;">Table of Contents</span></a></p></div><div style="clear:both;max-width:100%;position:relative;"><ix:continuation id="Tb_BxNKqgcPdUao_E9tv5KqRg_cont1"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">On March&#160;11, 2026, the Partnership issued <ix:nonFraction unitRef="Unit_Standard_shares_gSe3J7nwr0e79uzmUORQEQ" contextRef="Duration_3_11_2026_To_3_11_2026_srt_ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis_none_MonroeCapitalAssetBackedFinanceCompanyLpSeriesIiMember_us-gaap_StatementClassOfStockAxis_none_CommonClassEMember_JSVURQvrBUKSJkR7lf2fng" decimals="INF" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" scale="0" id="Narr_M4xZ6XFfUU-hQJwC76W9EA">600</ix:nonFraction> shares of Class I of Series II - subsequently redesignated as Class E Shares (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Shares</span>&#8221;) at the issue price of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="Unit_Divide_USD_shares_DZb9Dc-iF06n-l7weAlmww" contextRef="As_Of_3_11_2026_srt_ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis_none_MonroeCapitalAssetBackedFinanceCompanyLpSeriesIiMember_us-gaap_StatementClassOfStockAxis_none_CommonClassEMember_swMxkZFgo0C6QSOE5R7UJw" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:SharesIssuedPricePerShare" scale="0" id="Narr_Pd8Z-S7eckK8A7A_ATVrKA">25.00</ix:nonFraction> per share to Monroe Capital Intermediate Holdings, LLC, an affiliate of the Operating Manager. The purchase of shares in a Series&#160;of the Partnership is an investment only in that particular Series&#160;and not an investment in the Partnership as a whole. At the launch of the offering of its shares, the Partnership intends to only offer and accept subscriptions for shares of Series&#160;II.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">The Partnership has no operations as of June&#160;30, 2026, other than matters relating to its organization and offering and money market interest earned on cash received as part of the initial issuance of Shares on March&#160;11, 2026. The Partnership had neither purchased nor contracted to purchase any investments and had not commenced its investing activities.</p></ix:continuation><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="Duration_1_6_2026_To_6_30_2026_ziObVfHW60i3Aa7-v_9Twg" name="us-gaap:SignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock" id="Tb_azOCWy6K40mwZLIpEc8Qpg" continuedAt="Tb_azOCWy6K40mwZLIpEc8Qpg_cont1" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Note&#160;2. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies</p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="Duration_1_6_2026_To_6_30_2026_ziObVfHW60i3Aa7-v_9Twg" name="us-gaap:BasisOfAccountingPolicyPolicyTextBlock" id="Tb_XAMywkW6lk6kEu8V_x9AsA" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;"><span style="font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Basis of Accounting</span>&#8212;The financial statements were prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America (&#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">U.S. GAAP</span>&#8221;) and are presented in U.S. dollars, which is the Partnership&#8217;s functional currency. The Partnership&#8217;s financial statements are prepared using the accounting and reporting guidance under Financial Accounting Standards Board Accounting Standards Codification (ASC) 946, Financial Services&#160;&#8211; Investment Companies. The Partnership&#8217;s fiscal&#160;year end is December&#160;31.</p></ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="Duration_1_6_2026_To_6_30_2026_ziObVfHW60i3Aa7-v_9Twg" name="none:BasisOfPresentationPolicyPolicyTextBlock" id="Tb_uUKgGiEN7kyP9RbtfK7xRA" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;"><span style="font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Basis of Presentation&#8212;</span>Series&#160;I and Series&#160;II are intended to be treated as separate entities for U.S. federal income tax purposes with segregated assets, liabilities, and expenses. Allocation to each Series&#160;is based on attributable investment activity, Net Asset Value (&#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">NAV</span>&#8221;), or other equitable allocation methodologies as determined by the Operating Manager. These financial statements incorporate the assets and liabilities, and results of operations, of the Partnership as a whole, as well as each Series&#160;of interest in the Partnership.</p></ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="Duration_1_6_2026_To_6_30_2026_ziObVfHW60i3Aa7-v_9Twg" name="us-gaap:ConsolidationPolicyTextBlock" id="Tb_D5BlHU0mg0-YrD65ZAujjg" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;"><span style="font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Basis of Consolidation&#8212;</span>As provided under Regulation S-X and ASC 946, the Partnership will generally not consolidate its investment in a company other than a wholly owned investment company or controlled operating company whose business consists of providing services to the Partnership.</p></ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="Duration_1_6_2026_To_6_30_2026_ziObVfHW60i3Aa7-v_9Twg" name="us-gaap:UseOfEstimates" id="Tb_N6iZtSUWEEG0pnVX4U-Ztw" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;"><span style="font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Use of Estimate</span><b style="font-weight:bold;">s</b>&#8212;The preparation of financial statements in conformity with U.S. GAAP requires management to make estimates and assumptions that affect the reported amounts of assets and liabilities and disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities at the date of the financial statements and the reported amounts of income and expenses during the reporting period. Actual results could materially differ from those estimates.</p></ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="Duration_1_6_2026_To_6_30_2026_ziObVfHW60i3Aa7-v_9Twg" name="us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsPolicyTextBlock" id="Tb_xqySj8k2s0KWzdfET-FKAQ" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;"><span style="font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Cash and Cash Equivalents</span>&#8212;As of June&#160;30, 2026, cash and cash equivalents were comprised of cash on hand. The Partnership deposits its cash and cash equivalents with financial institutions and, at times, may exceed the FDIC insured limit. The Partnership earns interest income on balances primarily through money market funds.</p></ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="Duration_1_6_2026_To_6_30_2026_ziObVfHW60i3Aa7-v_9Twg" name="none:OrganizationalAndOfferingExpensesPolicyPolicyTextBlock" id="Tb_We1_HitJ30qS4fRGVpkXrQ" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;"><span style="font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Organizational and Offering Expenses</span>&#8212;Organizational expenses are expensed as incurred. Organizational expenses consist of costs incurred to establish the Partnership and enable it legally to do business. Organizational expenses will be reimbursed by the Operating Manager, subject to potential recoupment as described in Note&#160;3.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Offering expenses include registration fees and legal fees regarding the preparation of the initial registration statement. Offering expenses are accounted for as deferred costs until the commencement of investment activities and operations. For continuous offerings, offering expenses are then amortized over the first twelve&#160;months of operations on a straight-line basis. Refer to Note&#160;3 for additional information.</p></ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="Duration_1_6_2026_To_6_30_2026_ziObVfHW60i3Aa7-v_9Twg" name="us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementPolicyPolicyTextBlock" id="Tb_4nyWM2E220ahxy7Q3tNBuQ" continuedAt="Tb_4nyWM2E220ahxy7Q3tNBuQ_cont1" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;"><span style="font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Investments, At Fair Value</span>&#8212;ASC 820, Fair Value Measurement, defines fair value, establishes a framework for measuring fair value in accordance with GAAP and expands disclosures about fair value. The Partnership recognizes and accounts for its investments at fair value. The fair value of the investments does not reflect transactions costs that may be incurred upon disposition of investments.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date. Where available, fair value is based on observable market prices or parameters, or derived from such prices or parameters. Where observable prices or inputs are not available, valuation models are applied. These valuation techniques involve some level of management estimation and judgment, the degree of which is dependent on the price transparency for the instruments or market and the instruments&#8217; complexity for disclosure purposes.</p></ix:nonNumeric></ix:nonNumeric></div><div style="clear:both;margin-bottom:30pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:center;margin:24pt 0pt 0pt 0pt;">10</p></div></div>
<div style="background-color:#000000;clear:both;height:2pt;page-break-after:always;width:88.24%;border:0;margin:30pt 5.88% 30pt 5.88%;"></div><div style="max-width:100%;padding-left:5.88%;padding-right:5.88%;position:relative;"><div style="margin-top:21.6pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 0pt 30pt 0pt;"><a href="#TOC"><span style="font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;">Table of Contents</span></a></p></div><div style="clear:both;max-width:100%;position:relative;"><ix:continuation id="Tb_azOCWy6K40mwZLIpEc8Qpg_cont1"><ix:continuation id="Tb_4nyWM2E220ahxy7Q3tNBuQ_cont1"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Assets and liabilities recorded at fair value on the Statement of Assets and Liabilities are categorized based upon the level of judgment associated with the inputs used to measure their value. Hierarchical levels, as defined under GAAP, are directly related to the amount of subjectivity associated with the inputs to fair valuations of these assets and liabilities, are as follows:</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Level 1&#8212;Inputs are unadjusted, quoted prices in active markets for identical assets or liabilities at the measurement date.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Level 2&#8212;Inputs other than quoted prices included in Level 1 that are observable for the asset or liability, either directly or indirectly. Level 2 inputs include quoted prices for similar instruments in active markets, and inputs other than quoted prices that are observable for the asset or liability.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Level 3&#8212;Inputs are unobservable inputs for the asset or liability, and include situations where there is little, if any, market activity for the asset or liability.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">A significant decrease in the volume and level of activity for the asset or liability is an indication that transactions or quoted prices may not be representative of fair value because in such market conditions there may be increased instances of transactions that are not orderly. In those circumstances, further analysis of transactions or quoted prices is needed, and an adjustment to the transactions or quoted prices may be necessary to estimate fair value.</p></ix:continuation><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="Duration_1_6_2026_To_6_30_2026_ziObVfHW60i3Aa7-v_9Twg" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock" id="Tb_g4YkI09xb0K0WeNBexmVCw" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;"><span style="font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Income Taxes</span>&#8212;Series&#160;I intends to elect to be taxed as a corporation for U.S. federal income tax purposes. Series&#160;I is liable for income taxes, if any, on its net taxable income. There are <ix:nonFraction unitRef="Unit_Standard_shares_gSe3J7nwr0e79uzmUORQEQ" contextRef="As_Of_6_30_2026_srt_ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis_none_MonroeCapitalAssetBackedFinanceCompanyLpSeriesIMember_jbTev6nlnESlj0DQResZZQ" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" name="us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding" scale="0" id="Narr_-mDxPeeFukuKeVF1MAeQHQ">no</ix:nonFraction> shares outstanding or activity associated with Series&#160;I through June&#160;30, 2026.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Series&#160;II intends to operate so that it will qualify to be treated as a partnership for U.S. federal income tax purposes under the Internal Revenue Code and not a publicly traded partnership treated as a corporation. As such, it will not be subject to any U.S. federal, state and/or local income taxes. In any&#160;year, it is possible that Series&#160;II will not meet the qualifying income exception, which would result in Series&#160;II being treated as a publicly traded partnership taxed as a corporation, rather than a partnership. If Series&#160;II does not meet the qualifying income exception, the holders of interest in Series&#160;II would then be treated as stockholders in a corporation, and the Series&#160;II would become taxable as a corporation for U.S. federal income tax purposes. Series&#160;II would be required to pay income tax at corporate rates on its net taxable income. In addition, Series&#160;II intends to operate, in part, through subsidiaries that may be treated as corporations for U.S. or non-U.S. tax purposes and therefore may be subject to current and deferred U.S. federal, state and/or local income taxes at the subsidiary level.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt <div style="background-color:#000000;clear:both;height:2pt;page-break-after:always;width:88.24%;border:0;margin:30pt 5.88% 30pt 5.88%;"></div><div style="max-width:100%;padding-left:5.88%;padding-right:5.88%;position:relative;"><div style="margin-top:21.6pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 0pt 30pt 0pt;"><a href="#TOC"><span style="font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;">Table of Contents</span></a></p></div><div style="clear:both;max-width:100%;position:relative;"><ix:continuation id="Tb_1JxfuzmiFkO1c6AD3UurVg_cont1"></ix:continuation><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="Duration_1_6_2026_To_6_30_2026_ziObVfHW60i3Aa7-v_9Twg" name="us-gaap:SubsequentEventsTextBlock" id="Tb_1EBTyeORbk68Dp6bVPl31g" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Note&#160;5. Subsequent Events</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">A subsequent event is a significant event or transaction occurring between the balance sheet date and the issue date of the financial statements that could make the financial statements misleading if not recognized or disclosed. Unrecognized subsequent events consist of those events that provide evidence with respect to conditions that did not exist at the balance sheet date being reported on, but arose subsequent to that date. Management has evaluated subsequent events through August&#160;14, 2026, the date these financial statements were issued, and has identified the following events that require disclosure:</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Operating Agreement</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">On July&#160;17, 2026, the Partnership entered into an operating agreement (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Operating Agreement</span>&#8221;) with Monroe Capital Asset Finance Advisors, LLC (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Operating Manager</span>&#8221;), pursuant to which the Operating Manager is responsible for sourcing, evaluating and monitoring the Partnership&#8217;s investment opportunities and making recommendations related to the acquisition, management, financing and disposition of the Partnership&#8217;s assets. Under the Operating Agreement, the Partnership will pay the Operating Manager a management fee and a performance fee, as described in Note&#160;3 and Item&#160;2 &#8220;<i style="font-style:italic;">Management&#8217;s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations&#160;&#8211; Expenses.</i>&#8221;</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Administration Agreement</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">On July&#160;17, 2026, the Partnership entered into an administration agreement (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Administration Agreement</span>&#8221;) with Monroe Capital Management Advisors, LLC (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Administrator</span>&#8221;), an affiliate of the Operating Manager, pursuant to which the Administrator provides certain administrative services, personnel, and facilities necessary for the operations of the Partnership. The Partnership will reimburse the Administrator for its costs and expenses incurred in performing its obligations under the Administration Agreement as described in Note&#160;3 and Item&#160;2 &#8220;<i style="font-style:italic;">Management&#8217;s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations&#160;&#8211; Expenses.</i>&#8221;</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;"><i style="font-style:italic;">Limited Partnership Agreement</i></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">On July 17, 2026, the Partnership entered into its amended and restated limited partnership agreement (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Limited Partnership Agreement</span>&#8221;). The Limited Partnership Agreement sets forth the rights, duties, and obligations of the General Partner, the Board of Directors and the Shareholders, including provisions governing capital structure, transfer restrictions, investment and distribution mechanics, and the management and governance of the Partnership. The Limited Partnership Agreement is included as Exhibit 3.2 hereto.</p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;"><span style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</span></p></div><div style="clear:both;margin-bottom:30pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:center;margin:24pt 0pt 0pt 0pt;">14</p></div></div>
<div style="background-color:#000000;clear:both;height:2pt;page-break-after:always;width:88.24%;border:0;margin:30pt 5.88% 30pt 5.88%;"></div><div style="max-width:100%;padding-left:5.88%;padding-right:5.88%;position:relative;"><div style="margin-top:21.6pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 0pt 30pt 0pt;"><a href="#TOC"><span style="font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;">Table of Contents</span></a></p></div><div style="clear:both;max-width:100%;position:relative;"><a id="_54a01fb3_8f13_4bad_91c7_148ffa415337"></a><a id="Item2ManagementsDiscussionandAnalysisofF"></a><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;"><span style="display:inline-block;text-indent:0pt;width:36pt;"><b style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:bold;">Item&#160;2.</b></span>Management&#8217;s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;"><i style="font-style:italic;">The following discussion should be read in conjunction with the financial statements of the Partnership and notes thereto appearing in this Quarterly Report on Form&#160;10-Q and the financial statements of the Partnership included in the Form&#160;10. In addition to historical data, this discussion contains forward-looking statements about our business, operations and financial performance based on current expectations that involve risks, uncertainties and assumptions. Our actual results may differ materially from those in this discussion as a result of various factors, including but not limited to those discussed in &#8220;Part&#160;I, Item&#160;1A. Risk Factors&#8221; in the Form&#160;10.</i></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Overview</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">We were formed as a Delaware limited partnership on January&#160;6, 2026. We are sponsored by Monroe and through the Operating Manager we have access to Monroe&#8217;s asset sourcing, operations, and portfolio management capabilities pursuant to an operating agreement with the Operating Manager (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Operating Agreement</span>&#8221;).</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">We are a series limited partnership with series established pursuant to Sections 17-218(b)&#160;and Section&#160;17-221(c)&#160;of the Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">LP Act</span>&#8221;). The purchase of Shares of a Series&#160;is an investment only in that particular Series&#160;and not an investment in us as a whole. In accordance with the LP Act, a series is a separate series of assets or limited partnership interests of a partnership and not a separate legal entity.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Each of Series&#160;I and Series&#160;II were formed on February&#160;19, 2026 as a registered series of us. Each of Series&#160;I and Series&#160;II will remain in existence until its certificate of registered series has been cancelled in the manner required by the LP Act following Series&#160;I&#8217;s or Series&#160;II&#8217;s, as applicable, dissolution and the completion of the winding up of such Series&#160;in accordance with our limited partnership agreement (as amended from time to time, the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">LP Agreement</span>&#8221;), the applicable series agreement and Delaware law. The LP Agreement and the applicable series agreement provide that Series&#160;I or Series&#160;II will be dissolved upon (a)&#160;the adoption of a resolution by the Board approving the dissolution of Series&#160;I or Series&#160;II, as applicable, and the approval of such action by the General Partner, (b)&#160;the operations of Series&#160;I or Series&#160;II, as applicable, ceasing to constitute legal activities under the LP Act or any other applicable law (as determined by the Board), (c)&#160;the entry of a decree of judicial dissolution of a Series&#160;under Section&#160;17-218(b)(12) of the LP Act, or (d)&#160;our dissolution.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">We have no operating history and were formed to fund, finance and structure Asset-Backed Finance Assets. We are structured as a holding company and we conduct our operations directly and through wholly or majority-owned subsidiaries that primarily focus on Asset-Backed Finance Assets. Our principal office and place of business is at 155 N. Wacker Drive, 35th Floor, Chicago, IL 60606 and our telephone number is (312) 258-8300.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">On March&#160;11, 2026, we issued 600 shares of Class I of Series II - subsequently redesignated as Class&#160;E Shares (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Shares</span>&#8221;) at the aggregate issue price of $25.00 per share to Monroe Capital Intermediate Holdings, LLC, an affiliate of the Operating Manager. The purchase of shares in a Series&#160;of the Partnership is an investment only in that particular Series&#160;and not an investment in the Partnership as a whole. At the launch of the offering of its shares, the Partnership intends to only offer and accept subscriptions for shares of Series&#160;II.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt;">Our investment objective is to build a diversified portfolio of Asset-Backed Finance Assets that will generate attractive, risk-adjusted returns in the form of current income and, to a lesser extent, long-term capital appreciation across all economic cycles, targeting assets that have significant downside protection. We generally divide our Asset-Backed Finance Assets into two categories: (i)&#160;specialty finance assets, which include royalty finance, consumer finance, litigation finance and fund finance (&#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Specialty Finance</span>&#8221;) and (ii)&#160;hard assets, which include real estate, digital infrastructure, aircraft finance and equipment finance (&#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Hard Assets</span>&#8221;). In addition, we expect that a portion of our assets will consist of certain liquid asset classes, including, but not limited to, cash and cash equivalents, U.S. Treasury securities, U.S. government agency securities, municipal securities, other sovereign debt, investment grade credit and other investments including high-yield credit, asset-backed securities, mortgage backed securities, collateralized loan obligations, leveraged loans and/or debt of companies or assets (which may include (i)&#160;securities or loans for the Asset-Backed Finance Assets and/or (ii)&#160;funds invested in any of the foregoing managed by Monroe, its affiliates or a third-party manager) (collectively, the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Liquidity Portfolio</span>&#8221;) in order to provide us with income, to facilitate capital deployment and to provide a potential source of liquidity. These types of liquid assets may grow as a proportion of our assets at any given time due to new subscriptions, Shareholder participation in our share redemption program, distributions from, or dispositions of, Asset-Backed Finance Assets or for other reasons as our Operating Manager </p></div><div style="clear:both;margin-bottom:30pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:center;margin:24pt 0pt 0pt 0pt;">15</p></div></div>
<div style="background-color:#000000;clear:both;height:2pt;page-break-after:always;width:88.24%;border:0;margin:30pt 5.88% 30pt 5.88%;"></div><div style="max-width:100%;padding-left:5.88%;padding-right:5.88%;position:relative;"><div style="margin-top:21.6pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 0pt 30pt 0pt;"><a href="#TOC"><span style="font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;">Table of Contents</span></a></p></div><div style="clear:both;max-width:100%;position:relative;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">determines. We have significant liquidity requirements, and adverse market and economic conditions may adversely affect our sources of liquidity, which could materially and adversely affect our business operations.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Asset allocations are expected to be made primarily in (i)&#160;senior and junior secured and unsecured loans, notes, bonds, preferred equity (including preferred partnership equity), convertible debt and other securities; (ii)&#160;unitranche loans and securities; (iii)&#160;asset-backed loans, securities and other forward flow; (iv)&#160;small business loans and leases; (v)&#160;specialty finance facilities secured by pools of assets; (vi)&#160;consumer finance; (vii)&#160;litigation finance; (viii)&#160;commercial and residential real estate finance; (ix)&#160;aviation finance including leases; (x)&#160;equipment financing and leasing; (xi) structured debt and structured equity; (xii) ownership of specialty finance and ABF platforms; (xiii) digital infrastructure financings; (xiv) securitized debt and/or subordinated notes of collateralized loan obligation facilities and term transactions, asset-backed securities, and other securitized products of any kind that hold loans to corporate borrowers and other instruments and issue securities based on their underlying assets (including, without limitation, any or all series and/or tranches thereof, whether senior or junior or debt or equity) and any warehouse finance vehicles or facilities for such vehicles or products; (xv) opportunistic acquisitions or illiquid investments from Monroe advised funds or other third-party funds caused by liquidity constraints resulting from investor redemptions and market dislocations or fund liquidations; (xvi) secondary opportunities in pooled-investment funds managed by a third-party investment adviser; (xvii) fund-level financing backed by the residual value of third-party fund assets; (xviii) private and public equity on an opportunistic basis; (xix) capital investments in the asset-backed securities (&#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">ABS</span>&#8221;), residential mortgage-backed securities, commercial mortgage-backed securities and secondary markets. MAB will seek to take advantage of the supply and demand gap in multiple segments of the private credit markets throughout an economic cycle and leverage it to assist the Partnership with sourcing a wide range of Asset Backed Finance Assets, in accordance with the Partnership&#8217;s investment objective.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">We intend to operate our business in a manner such that neither Series&#160;will be defined as an investment company, as that term is used under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Investment Company Act</span>&#8221;).</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Results of Operations</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">From January&#160;6, 2026 (date of formation) through June&#160;30, 2026, we were in our organizational period, had not commenced our principal operations and were focused on our formation and the Form&#160;10. Our Form&#160;10 automatically became effective on June&#160;12, 2026. We will be dependent upon the proceeds from our continuous private offering of our Shares on a&#160;monthly basis (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Private Offering</span>&#8221;) in order to conduct our business. We intend to acquire Asset-Backed Finance Assets with the capital received from our Private Offering and any indebtedness that we may incur in connection with such activities.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Income</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">We plan to generate income primarily by building a diversified portfolio of Asset-Backed Finance Assets that will generate attractive, risk-adjusted returns in the form of current income and, to a lesser extent, long-term capital appreciation across all economic cycles, targeting assets that have significant downside protection. During the three months ended June 30, 2026 and the period from January 6, 2026 (date of formation) through June 30, 2026, the only income earned was on money market interest earned on cash received as a part of the initial issuance of Shares on March 11, 2026 of $87 and $117, respectively.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Expenses</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Management Fee</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Pursuant to the Operating Agreement we entered into on July 17, 2026, we will pay the Operating Manager a management fee (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Management Fee</span>&#8221;). The Management Fee is payable&#160;monthly in arrears in an amount equal to (i)&#160;1.00% per annum of the&#160;month-end total assets attributable to the Standard Fee Class&#160;Shares, (ii)&#160;0.80% per annum of the&#160;month-end total assets attributable to the Founder Share Class&#160;II Shares, (iii)&#160;0.70% per annum of the&#160;month-end total assets attributable to the Founder Share Class&#160;III Shares. The Operating Manager or an affiliate may rebate, waive or reduce the Management Fee charged to certain Shareholders and/or certain Share classes at the sole discretion of the Operating Manager or such affiliate. Any such rebate, waiver or reduction may be effected either by way of purchase of additional Shares by the Operating Manager or such affiliate for the Shareholder or by way of rebate to the relevant Shareholder&#8217;s account. The Management Fee may alternatively, in the discretion of the Operating Manager, instead be paid in whole or in part by our subsidiaries, in which case it shall result in a change in the cash or retained earnings of such subsidiaries.</p></div><div style="clear:both;margin-bottom:30pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:center;margin:24pt 0pt 0pt 0pt;">16</p></div></div>
<div style="background-color:#000000;clear:both;height:2pt;page-break-after:always;width:88.24%;border:0;margin:30pt 5.88% 30pt 5.88%;"></div><div style="max-width:100%;padding-left:5.88%;padding-right:5.88%;position:relative;"><div style="margin-top:21.6pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 0pt 30pt 0pt;"><a href="#TOC"><span style="font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;">Table of Contents</span></a></p></div><div style="clear:both;max-width:100%;position:relative;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Performance Fee</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">So long as the Operating Agreement has not been terminated, the Operating Manager will be entitled to receive a performance fee (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Performance Fee</span>&#8221;) equal to (i)&#160;15.00% of the Total Return (as defined below) with respect to Standard Fee Class&#160;Shares, (ii)&#160;12.00% of the Total Return with respect to Founder Share Class&#160;II Shares and (iii)&#160;10.50% of the Total Return with respect to Founder Share Class&#160;III Shares and Class&#160;E-W Shares, in each case subject to a 6.00% Hurdle Amount and a High Water Mark with respect to such class of Shares, with a Catch-Up (each term as defined below). Such fee will accrue and be paid quarterly. The Performance Fee will not be paid on Class&#160;E Shares, and as a result, it is an expense specific only to certain Investor Shares and Class&#160;E-W Shares at the rates specified herein, which will result in the dilution of Investor Shares and Class&#160;E-W Shares in proportion to the fees charged to different classes of Investor Shares and Class&#160;E-W Shares.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Specifically, the Operating Manager will be entitled to receive a Performance Fee in an amount equal to:</p><table style="border-collapse:collapse;font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;table-layout:fixed;text-align:justify;width:100%;border:0pt;"><tr><td style="width:36pt;"/><td style="font-family:'Times New (w)&#160;applicable taxes for the&#160;year, (x)&#160;changes resulting solely from the proceeds of issuances of additional Shares, (y)&#160;any fee/accrual to the Performance Fee and Shares.</span></td></tr></table><div style="margin-top:12pt;"></div><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">For the avoidance of doubt, the calculation of Total Return will (i)&#160;include any appreciation or depreciation in the transactional NAV of any relevant Shares issued during the then-current calendar&#160;year but (ii)&#160;exclude the proceeds from the initial issuance of such Shares.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">&#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Hurdle Amount</span>&#8221; with respect to any Shares means, for any period during a calendar&#160;year, that amount that results in a 6.00% annualized Total Return on the transactional NAV of such Shares outstanding at the beginning of the then-current calendar&#160;year and such Shares issued since the beginning of the then-current calendar&#160;year, taking into account the timing and amount of all distributions accrued or paid (without duplication) on all such Shares and all issuances of any such Shares over the period and calculated in accordance with recognized industry practices. The ending transactional NAV of such Shares used in calculating the Total Return will be calculated before giving effect to any fee/accrual to the Performance Fee and applicable combined annual distribution fee and shareholder servicing fee expenses and applicable taxes; <i style="font-style:italic;">provided</i> that the calculation of the Hurdle Amount for any period will exclude any such Shares redeemed during such period, which Shares will be subject to the Performance Fee upon redemption.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt;">&#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Loss Carryforward Amount</span>&#8221; with respect to any Shares shall initially equal zero and shall cumulatively increase by the absolute value of any negative annual Total Return with respect to such Shares and decrease by any positive annual Total Return with respect to such Shares;<i style="font-style:italic;"> provided</i> that each Loss Carryforward Amount shall at no time be less than zero; <i style="font-style:italic;">provided</i>,<i style="font-style:italic;"> further</i> that the calculation of each Loss Carryforward Amount will exclude the Total Return related to any relevant Shares redeemed during such&#160;year, which Shares will be subject to the Performance Fee upon redemption. The effect of the Loss Carryforward Amount is that the </p></div><div style="clear:both;margin-bottom:30pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:center;margin:24pt 0pt 0pt 0pt;">17</p></div></div>
<div style="background-color:#000000;clear:both;height:2pt;page-break-after:always;width:88.24%;border:0;margin:30pt 5.88% 30pt 5.88%;"></div><div style="max-width:100%;padding-left:5.88%;padding-right:5.88%;position:relative;"><div style="margin-top:21.6pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 0pt 30pt 0pt;"><a href="#TOC"><span style="font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;">Table of Contents</span></a></p></div><div style="clear:both;max-width:100%;position:relative;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">recoupment of past annual Total Return losses will offset the positive annual Total Return for purposes of the calculation of the Performance Fee. This is referred to as a &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">High Water Mark</span>.&#8221;</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">The Operating Manager may, in its discretion and without further notice to or consent of any Shareholder, afford particular Shareholders more favorable terms with respect to the Performance Fee, and such more favorable terms may be set forth in a side letter or other similar written agreement with such Shareholder.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Selling Commissions and Ongoing Distribution and Servicing Fees</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Participating broker-dealers will be entitled to receive selling commissions of up to 3.50% of the transaction price of each Standard Fee Class-S Shares, Founder Share Class&#160;II-S Shares and Founder Share Class&#160;III-S Shares. Participating broker-dealers will receive a combined annual distribution fee and shareholder servicing fee of 0.85% per annum of the aggregate transactional NAV of our outstanding Standard Fee Class-S Shares, Founder Share Class&#160;II-S Shares and Founder Share Class&#160;III-S Shares. There will not be a combined annual distribution fee and shareholder servicing fee or upfront selling commission with respect to the Standard Fee Class-I Shares, Founder Share Class&#160;II-I Shares and Founder Share Class&#160;III-I Shares.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Monroe Shares will not incur any upfront selling costs or ongoing servicing costs.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Administration</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Monroe Capital Management Advisors, LLC (&#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">MCMA</span>&#8221; or the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Administrator</span>&#8221;), an affiliate of the Operating Manager, is registered as an investment adviser under the Advisers Act and will provide and be reimbursed for certain administrative and accounting services to us, including preparing the NAV calculation, pursuant to an administration agreement (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Administration Agreement</span>&#8221;) dated July 17, 2026. The Administrator will provide, or oversee the performance of, administrative services for us. We will reimburse the Administrator for its costs, expenses and our allocable portion of compensation of the Administrator&#8217;s personnel (including travel expenses) and the Administrator&#8217;s overhead (including rent) and other expenses incurred by the Administrator in performing its administrative obligations under the Administration Agreement.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Organizational and Offering Expenses</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">We and the Series&#160;will incur organizational and offering expenses in connection with the formation and organization of the Partnership and the Series, and the offering of Shares to investors, including legal, accounting, printing, mailing and filing fees and expenses, taxes, due diligence expenses of participating broker-dealers supported by detailed and itemized invoices, costs in connection with preparing sales materials, design, website and electronic database expenses, fees and expenses of our escrow agent and transfer agent, fees to attend retail seminars sponsored by participating broker-dealers and reimbursements for customary travel, lodging and meals and other similar fees, costs and expenses but excluding upfront selling commissions and the combined annual distribution fees and shareholder servicing fees (collectively, the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Organizational and Offering Expenses</span>&#8221;).</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Expense Support and Conditional Reimbursement of the Operating Manager</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">We have entered into an expense support and conditional reimbursement agreement with the Operating Manager and Administrator pursuant to which each of the Operating Manager and the Administrator may elect to pay certain of our expenses, including certain Organizational and Offering Expenses on our behalf (each, an &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Expense Support</span>&#8221;).</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">Following any calendar&#160;month in which the Specified Expenses (as defined below) are below 1.00% of our net assets on an annualized basis, we shall reimburse the Operating Manager and Administrator, fully or partially, for the Expense Support, but only if and to the extent that Specified Expenses plus any Reimbursement Payment (as defined below) do not exceed 1.00% of our net assets at the end of each calendar&#160;month on an annualized basis, until such time as all Expense Support made by the Operating Manager and Administrator to us within five&#160;years prior to the last business day of such calendar&#160;month have been reimbursed; provided, however, if the Operating Manager and the Administrator are to only receive partial repayment of Expense Support, they shall be paid in proportion to the Expense Support outstanding of each entity relative to the aggregate outstanding Expense Support. Any payments required to be made by us in the prior sentence shall be referred to as a &#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Reimbursement Payment</span>.&#8221;</p></div><div style="clear:both;margin-bottom:30pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:center;margin:24pt 0pt 0pt 0pt;">18</p></div></div>
<div style="background-color:#000000;clear:both;height:2pt;page-break-after:always;width:88.24%;border:0;margin:30pt 5.88% 30pt 5.88%;"></div><div style="max-width:100%;padding-left:5.88%;padding-right:5.88%;position:relative;"><div style="margin-top:21.6pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 0pt 30pt 0pt;"><a href="#TOC"><span style="font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;">Table of Contents</span></a></p></div><div style="clear:both;max-width:100%;position:relative;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;">&#8220;<span style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Specified Expenses</span>&#8221; means all expenses incurred in our business with the exception of (i)&#160;the Management Fee, (ii)&#160;the Performance Fee, (iii)&#160;our combined annual distribution fees and shareholder servicing fees and the special purchase vehicles, (iv)&#160;the distribution and servicing fees (including selling commissions), (v)&#160;expenses related to any investments acquired by us and a special purchase vehicle, including, without limitation, brokerage costs or other acquisition-related out-of-pocket expenses (regardless of whether the transactions are consummated), (vi)&#160;ordinary corporate operating expenses of the Partnership and special purchase vehicles, (vii)&#160;interest expenses, commitment fees, or other expenses related to any leverage incurred by us, (viii)&#160;taxes, (ix)&#160;certain insurance costs, (x)&#160;Organizational and Offering Expenses, (xi) certain non-routine items (as determined in the sole discretion of the Operating Manager) and (xii) extraordinary expenses (as determined in the sole discretion of the Operating Manager). As of June 30, 2026, the Operating Manager had elected to bear organizational and offering expenses of Series II totaling $1,566,669 and $446,415, respectively, of which $573,245 of organizational expenses and $179,875 of offering expenses had been paid to, or settled directly with, the applicable vendors as of that date. None of the Expense Support has been reimbursed by the Partnership as of June 30, 2026.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt election processes in connection therewith; (xxiii) the winding up and termination of the Partnership generally or the Series; (xxiv) all fees, costs and expenses incurred in connection with special purpose vehicles and subsidiaries of the Partnership generally or the Series&#160;or other investment structures (including any alternative investment vehicles and any platform entities used to facilitate one or more investments, including any real estate investment trust within the meaning of Section&#160;856 of the Code, by the Partnership generally or the Series) to facilitate the Partnership&#8217;s (generally) or the Series&#8217; (xxvii) administration fees and expenses, if any, provided by the Operating Manager to the Partnership generally or the Series&#160;(including any expenses payable under the administration agreement with the Operating Manager, payments based upon the Partnership&#8217;s allocable portion of the Operating Manager&#8217;s overhead in performing its obligations under this Agreement, including rent and the allocable portion of the cost (including total compensation) of legal, finance and other support personnel of Monroe, the Operating Manager or their affiliates in connection with the operations and management of the Partnership generally and the Series;
